## Professional Positioning

Haoming Koo is a Senior Software Development Engineer (AI Agentic) at AMD in Singapore and a Certified AI Engineer by AI Singapore. He completed AI Singapore's AI Apprenticeship Programme in July 2026 after building production ML systems including a 100E industry AI solution for complex operational planning. Before AI Singapore he spent 7 years at Micron Technology, most recently as Manager of Front End Central Process Integration Engineering, leading AI-enabled transformation across four fabs (Singapore, Boise, Hiroshima, Taichung); programs he led, co-led, or supported identified USD 600M+ in opportunities, with USD 50M+ realized. He holds an MSc in Smart Industries and Digital Transformation from the National University of Singapore (2022, GPA 4.85/5.00) and builds and maintains 8 live AI products at kooexperience.com.

## Career History

- AMD — Senior Software Development Engineer (AI Agentic), August 2026–present.
- AI Singapore — Associate AI Engineer, AI Apprenticeship Programme (AIAP), January–July 2026. Graduated as a Certified AI Engineer.
- Micron Technology — 7 years, most recently Manager, Front End Central Process Integration Engineering (August 2022–January 2025). Led a team of 6 direct and 9 indirect engineers and a USD 9M operational portfolio across four fabs.
- Tagvance x Maritime & Port Authority of Singapore — Capstone Consultant, Geospatial Analytics (2021). Industrial IoT and applied ML for maritime safety and enforcement.
- Singapore Institute of Manufacturing Technology (SIMTech) — Scientist Intern (2016–2017). R&D in bio-lasing technologies.
- National University of Singapore — Undergraduate Researcher (2016). Hydrogen evolution catalyst research.

## Education

- Master of Science, Smart Industries and Digital Transformation — National University of Singapore (2020–2022), GPA 4.85/5.00. Capstone: smart-port IoT and sensor-based logistics with the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore.
- Bachelor of Science (Honours, Distinction), Chemistry with Nanoscience minor — National University of Singapore (2017), with an exchange at Simon Fraser University, Canada.
- Full Stack Development with AI, NUS x Emeritus (2025).

Disambiguation: Haoming Koo's degrees are from the National University of Singapore (NUS). SIMTech is the Singapore Institute of Manufacturing Technology, an A*STAR research institute where he interned in 2016–2017 — it is not the Singapore Institute of Technology (SIT). He did not attend SIT or Singapore Polytechnic.

## Selected Live Products

- [Job Hunter SG](https://job.kooexperience.com): Singapore job search and resume workflow with live listings, nightly refresh, semantic matching via sentence-transformer embeddings, ATS scoring, resume tailoring behind 5 anti-hallucination validation gates, an MCP server interface, and extensive automated coverage. [Source](https://github.com/haomingkoo/job-hunter-sg).
- [Trader Koo](https://trader.kooexperience.com): evidence-first market research workflow with source freshness, ranked setups, paper-trade audit trails, and alerts. [Case study](https://kooexperience.com/projects/trader-koo.html). [Source](https://github.com/haomingkoo/trader-koo).
- [Japan in Seasons](https://seasons.kooexperience.com): live Japan seasonal travel map, REST API, and MCP server with 17 read-only tools and 1,700+ places. [Case study](https://kooexperience.com/projects/japan-in-seasons.html). [Source](https://github.com/haomingkoo/japan-seasons-mcp).
- [Amex Explorer](https://amex-explorer.kooexperience.com): source-backed Amex Platinum benefit explorer with maps, source hashes, review alerts, and Table for Two availability checks. [Source](https://github.com/haomingkoo/amex-dining-map).
- [LionWeather](https://lionweather.kooexperience.com): Singapore weather intelligence with LightGBM rainfall forecasting and SHAP analysis. [Source](https://github.com/haomingkoo/lionweather).
- [Photo Compliance Studio](https://studio.kooexperience.com): passport-style photo compliance checks with MediaPipe and OpenCV. [Case study](https://kooexperience.com/projects/photo-compliance-studio.html). [Source](https://github.com/haomingkoo/photo-id-studio).
- [Preflight](https://preflight.kooexperience.com): automated EDA and baseline ML for CSV/Parquet files. [Source](https://github.com/haomingkoo/preflight).
- [MinMax Wine](https://wine.kooexperience.com): Singapore wine price comparison and deal scoring. [Source](https://github.com/haomingkoo/grandcru-value-api).

## Selected Research Note

- [Long COVID evidence pipeline and supervised rehabilitation](https://kooexperience.com/blog/posts/what-i-learned-building-a-deep-research-pipeline-for-long-covid.html): interim, source-linked research note explaining a 73,857-record PubMed pipeline and one plausible treatment lane through six selected randomized rehabilitation trials. The article distinguishes statistical significance from clinical importance, links every primary paper, and explicitly states that it is not medical advice or a completed systematic review.

## Portfolio Guide

The website's public chat guide runs through a narrowly scoped Cloudflare Worker and the SEA-LION API. It grounds answers on this public `llms.txt` file, limits input and conversation history, rate-limits requests, and links answers back to public portfolio or project sources. The website itself remains hosted on GitHub Pages; no private employer or client data is included in the guide.
